newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klima urges budget discipline in 98/99.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klima urges budget discipline in 98/99.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima, in his first parliamentary speech in his new post, said on Wednesday the government would exercise budget discipline in 1998 and 1999 without squeezing ordinary people.
Klima said strict cost-cutting measures contained in the 1996 and 1997 budgets had already contributed to an improvement in Austria's fiscal health.
"By sticking to the 1997 budget and bringing in the necessary reforms in 1998 and 1999, we will not need to impose an austerity package on the people," the former finance minister said.
Negotiations on the 1998 and 1999 budgets would be completed by this summer, he added. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-254
